Each part of the process
held to one standard.

I

Before a transaction

Whether reported performance reflects the true quality of the business, established before an investment decision is made.

II

After a transaction

The insight a new owner needs to steer value creation: strategy aligned, governance strengthened, priorities made clear.

III

During ownership

Strategic control kept as the company grows faster than any one owner can oversee.

IV

Before exit

A credible equity story and a stronger negotiating position, prepared well before the process begins.
